title: Work-rate with efficiency drop + bonus completion clause
text: Worker A alone completes a job in 19 hours and Worker B alone in 9 hours. They work together for 4 hours. If by then less than 76% of the job is done, they add Worker C who works at 1.8 times A’s rate; otherwise A’s efficiency drops by 34% for the remaining time due to fatigue. Additionally, if the job finishes before 7 hours total, they receive a bonus 484 split proportional to individual hours worked. Find the total completion time and A’s bonus share.
